hints: Use the trapezium rule on three equal strips of the interval $0\le x\le \pi/4$.
The strip width is $h=(\pi/4)/3=\pi/12$, so evaluate $\sqrt{1-\tan x}$ at $x=0,\pi/12,\pi/6,\pi/4$.
Apply $\frac h2[y_0+2(y_1+y_2)+y_3]$ and round only the final estimate to 3 decimal places.
walkthrough: Identify the integration limits $a = 0$ and $b = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$, with $n = 3$ intervals.

Determine the $x$-coordinates of the four ordinates:
$$x_0 = 0$$
$$x_1 = 0 + \dfrac{\pi}{12} = \dfrac{\pi}{12}$$
$$x_2 = \dfrac{\pi}{12} + \dfrac{\pi}{12} = \dfrac{\pi}{6}$$
$$x_3 = \dfrac{\pi}{6} + \dfrac{\pi}{12} = \dfrac{\pi}{4}$$

Evaluate the integrand $f(x) = \sqrt{1 - \tan x}$ at each ordinate:
$$y_0 = f(0) = \sqrt{1 - \tan 0} = \sqrt{1 - 0} = 1$$
$$y_1 = f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}\right) = \sqrt{1 - \tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{12}\right)} = \sqrt{1 - (2 - \sqrt{3})} = \sqrt{\sqrt{3} - 1} \approx \sqrt{0.7320508} \approx 0.8555997$$
$$y_2 = f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sqrt{1 - \tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)} = \sqrt{1 - \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}} \approx \sqrt{1 - 0.5773503} = \sqrt{0.4226497} \approx 0.6501151$$
$$y_3 = f\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right) = \sqrt{1 - \tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)} = \sqrt{1 - 1} = 0$$

State the trapezium rule formula for 3 intervals:
$$T = \dfrac{h}{2} \left[ y_0 + y_3 + 2(y_1 + y_2) \right]$$
$$T = \dfrac{\frac{\pi}{12}}{2} \left[ 1 + 0 + 2(0.8555997 + 0.6501151) \right]$$

Multiply by $\dfrac{h}{2} = \dfrac{\pi}{24}$:
$$T = \dfrac{\pi}{24} \times 4.0114296 \approx 0.1308997 \times 4.0114296 \approx 0.525095$$
Rounding to 3 decimal places gives $0.525$.
